title: Code and logs for: New values of the largest Littlewood-Richardson coefficient via iterated Okounkov compression

creators.name: Ruiz Loera, Andre
creators.affiliation: Department of Mathematics, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign

description: Scripts and raw computation logs, exactly as submitted as ancillary files with the paper, computing the largest Littlewood-Richardson coefficient C(n) for 46 <= n <= 53 (OEIS A387851) by iterated Okounkov compression and verifying both parts of the Pak-Soskin conjecture on the maximizers. Includes the independent verification gates: an lrcalc-free tableau-enumeration crosscheck, an exhaustive brute-force gate for 2 <= n <= 28, and an independent terminal-vector rerun of the scan.
